artDirection: Hazard yellow (#facc15) line art and accents on a matte-black background; flat minimalist scientific-textbook style; crisp sentence-case sans-serif labels; legible at 2x; no photorealism, no watermark; high contrast.
note: Produce each PNG with the genmedia MCP image tool (Nano Banana Pro) into this directory as lesson1.png .. lesson6.png, then run `cargo run --example author_seed_lessons` from src-tauri/. See docs/LESSONS_AUTHORING.md.

figures.prompt: The mole concept and molar mass: a balance scale relating grams to moles, Avogadro's number 6.022 x 10^23, and 'grams / molar mass = moles'; H2O labeled 18.02 g/mol.
A balanced chemical equation with per-element atom-count bars equal on both sides (2 H2 + O2 -> 2 H2O).
A dimensional-analysis railroad converting grams of a reactant to grams of a product through the mole ratio.
Two reactant consumption bars draining to reveal the limiting reagent and leftover excess, with the theoretical yield.
A titration curve of pH versus titrant volume with the equivalence point marked.
An ideal-gas PV explorer at STP showing one mole occupying 22.41 L and the PV = nRT relationship.
